title: comfy stop
description: Output shape for the stop command's success envelope.

dry_run.description: True when --dry-run was passed: nothing was stopped and `stopped` is false.

untracked.description: True when the target was found by --port rather than read from this CLI's background record.

verified.description: --port only: the listener was positively identified as ComfyUI before being reported.

cmdline.description: --port --dry-run only: the identified listener's command line.

cwd.description: --port --dry-run only: the identified listener's working directory, when readable.

children_unknown.description: --port only: present and true when the target's child processes could not be enumerated, so the stop is confirmed for the listener and the port but not for its whole tree.
